title: Maximum Length of a Concatenated String with Unique Characters
description: Find the maximum length of a string formed by concatenating a subsequence of an array, such that all characters in the resulting string are unique.
pseudocode:
1. function solve(index, currentMask):
2.   maxLen = countSetBits(currentMask)
3.   for i from index to arr.length:
4.     if (currentMask & bitmask[i]) == 0:
5.       maxLen = max(maxLen, solve(i + 1, currentMask | bitmask[i]))
6.   return maxLen
